title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A guard that was checking half of what it claimed
summary: The test added yesterday required zero array scans, which is also what a function that does nothing produces. It now proves the work happened first.

highlights.title: No behaviour change
highlights.description: Emptying the guarded function, or deleting the sort it watches, both left the test green. All three ways of breaking the code now fail it.

sections.heading: Internal
bullets: The test checks that the sort ran and discarded the file that went stale during the batch, before certifying how the sort was done.
Nothing changes for anyone using the extension.
